description.text: The third expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 5 June 2020 and led by Eternatus VMAX, the third legendary Pokémon of the Galar region. Its Ability lets its player have up to eight Darkness-type Pokémon on the Bench, and its attack does up to 270 damage. Crobat V, Drednaw VMAX, Scizor VMAX and Salamence VMAX join it, with the Supporters Piers and Rose and the Stadium Rose Tower. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Coalossal, Turbo Patch and Capture Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Darkness Ablaze in August 2020.
